eventText: An inmate corners you in the yard. You're going to have to deal with this.

success.outcomeText: You held your own. Word got around.

choices.outcomeText: It won't be the last time they come for you.
Some inmates now see you as a snitch.

eventText: A debt collection agency has started calling your mobile. Three times yesterday.

choices.text: Answer and negotiate a payment plan.
choices.outcomeText: They agreed to monthly installments. The calls stop.
They'll find another way to reach you.
You have a plan now. It's manageable.

eventText: You wake up shaking. The craving is overwhelming. You know what you need to do — both options are clear.

choices.outcomeText: The relief is immediate and hollow.

choices.text: Call a support line and push through.
choices.outcomeText: The hardest day in a long time. But you made it.

eventText: Your doctor asks if you've thought about end-of-life planning. You haven't, but you should.

choices.text: Write a will and set up a health directive.
choices.outcomeText: It was sobering, but you feel a strange peace.

choices.text: Tell them you're not ready to think about it.
